description: This file defines the MemoryPanel class, which provides methods to interact with the Memory panel and related UI elements in a calculator application's UI test framework. It includes methods for opening panels, retrieving memory items, and resizing the application window.

classes.name: MemoryPanel
classes.description: A class providing UI automation methods for the calculator's Memory panel, including opening panels, retrieving memory items, and resizing the window to ensure UI elements are visible.

methods.name: OpenMemoryPanel
methods.description: Opens the Memory panel by clicking the Memory label and ensuring it is displayed.

methods.name: GetAllMemoryListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all memory items listed in the Memory panel.

methods.name: ClearMemoryPanel
methods.description: Opens the Memory panel and clicks the clear button if it is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayMemoryLabel
methods.description: Resizes the window until the Memory label is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayMemoryButton
methods.description: Resizes the window until the Memory button is visible.

methods.name: GetAllMemoryFlyoutListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all memory items listed in the Memory flyout.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowMemoryLabel
methods.description: Recursively increases window size until the Memory label is visible or maximum size is reached.

methods.name: ShrinkWindowToShowMemoryButton
methods.description: Recursively decreases window size until the Memory button is visible or minimum size is reached.
